_comment: Mutation-testing quality gate (#127). Observed ~60% locally on 0.6.0 (net10.0, Standard level, 2026-08-10). 'break' fails the run below this score and is the release-gate floor enforced by the weekly stryker.yaml run. Set conservatively below the observed score for a non-flaky first CI run — CI timeout-mutant behavior can differ from local — and intended to be ratcheted up as surviving mutants are addressed (the 0.5.0/0.6.0 additions are line-covered but under-asserted). Run: `dotnet stryker`.
